title: Contract sync
description: Brings a resource's contract in line with its Drizzle table (body schema, sort and filter fields, list query, responses), then the service's queries and the specs' sample bodies.

name.description: Resource name, singular or plural (e.g. orders). Leave it out with --all.

all.description: Every table that has a contract.

service.description: Also sync the service's queries (list, detail, create, update) and its spec.
